about: Texture kinds of 'satk shader textures --kind'. A name belongs to a kind when it is in the kind's scope and one rule path holds: 'names' (name globs, MTA syntax), 'surfaces' (collision surface of the texture from data/colgen/tex_surface.json: ids, share %, votes), 'models' (share of the name's model uses on models with IDE flags 'flags' or names 'model_names'), 'lod' (share of uses on LOD models), 'paint' (material of a recolourable vehicle colour slot) or 'all'; 'exclude' globs always win. Scopes: world = used by an objs/tobj/anim model; vehicle = in a TXD of a vehicle model or vehicle.txd; ped = in a TXD of a ped model or player.img; any = every texture. 'fallback' are the patterns used without an index. Heuristics: check the list before shipping a shader.

road.about: driving surfaces: asphalt, junctions, crossings, freeway lanes and road blends of world models

pavement.about: sidewalks, kerbs and paved squares of world models

grass.about: lawns, meadows, golf and dry grass of world models

dirt.about: dirt, mud and gravel ground of world models

sand.about: sand and beach ground of world models

rock.about: rock and cliff faces of world models

glass.about: windows and glass panes of world models (vehicle glass shares vehiclegeneric256 with other parts: use kind vehicle)

water.about: water surfaces: the sea and pools (waterclear256), waterfalls, dirty water and boat wakes

tree.about: trees, palms, bushes and hedges: leaves and bark of world models

lod.about: textures only LOD models use (the low-detail distant versions)

vehicle.about: every texture of vehicle TXDs and vehicle.txd; pair with dxCreateShader elementTypes 'vehicle'

vehicle_paint.about: textures of recolourable vehicle paint materials (colour slots 1-4); untextured paint materials cannot be matched by name

ped.about: every texture of ped TXDs and player.img (clothes of CJ); pair with dxCreateShader elementTypes 'ped'
